name: Kudou Seiji
source:
The protagonist's friend. He's a well known womanizer, and is known as the "the walking sex organ".

Even though he looks sleazy, he's a good person deep down. It's just that he can't stop womanizing.

He's always giving sexual advice to the protagonist so that he can experiment with Chinatsu.
